item.title: Public status site and operator dashboard
item.description: Plans for user-facing public status (status.samplayskeys.com) and a private operator “single pane of glass,” with acceptance criteria, sequencing, and open decisions. Phase 1 — Public status site URL: status.samplayskeys.com Audience: Partner and other users of user-facing services (not homelab admins). Tone / UX: Similar to GitHub Status: components (or service groups), overall status, recent incident history, minimal jargon.
